definition_zh: 马勒，笼头；约束，克制；（马）昂首表示嗔怒
definition_en: the headgear used to control a horse; to restrain or check; of a horse, to raise the head in anger
core_image: 缰绳勒住马嘴，也勒住人心里那匹烈马
scene: 马厩里骑手给马套上笼头，马却把脖子一挺。She bridled at the suggestion that she had cheated.
sceneCN: 这里 bridle 是动词「（因受辱而）面露怒色、昂首嗔怒」（第 3 个义项：像马被勒住一样昂头动怒）；句意是她听到说她作弊的建议便勃然变色。

pos.zh: （马）昂首挣勒；（人）动怒，面露愠色

collocations.phrase: put a bridle on a horse

derivatives.zh: 由 bridle 加 way 构成，义为「马道；驮马小径」
由 un- 加 bridle 加 -ed 构成，义为「不受约束的；放纵的」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「备马勒的人」

senses.title: Headgear for a horse
senses.definition: the set of straps and a bit placed on a horse's head to control it
senses.definitionCN: 套在马头上、由革带和嚼口组成的控马器具
senses.example: She lifted the bridle off its hook in the tack room.
senses.exampleCN: 她从马具房的挂钩上取下马勒。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the concrete object that holds and guides the horse.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是那个实在的、勒住并引导马匹的器具。

senses.title: To restrain or check
senses.definition: to control or hold back a person, feeling or activity, as a bridle holds a horse
senses.definitionCN: 像马勒勒马那样控制或约束人、情绪或行为
senses.example: New rules tried to bridle the spending of local councils.
senses.exampleCN: 新规章试图约束地方议会的开支。
senses.why: The tool becomes a verb: whatever the straps do to the horse, people do to feelings and conduct.
senses.whyCN: 器具转为动词：革带对马做的事，转喻为人对情绪与行为的管束。

senses.title: To show sudden anger
senses.definition: to draw the head back and show offence or anger, like a horse feeling the bit
senses.definitionCN: 像马感到嚼口那样昂头后仰，表示受到冒犯
senses.example: He bridled at the word coward and said nothing.
senses.exampleCN: 听到「懦夫」二字，他昂首变色，一言不发。
senses.why: A horse reacts to the bit by tossing its head; people react to insult the same way.
senses.whyCN: 马因嚼口而昂头，人因冒犯而昂首，动作与情绪同构。

intro.en: Bridle descends from an Old English word for the headgear of a horse.
intro.cn: bridle 由古英语中指马首器具的词演变而来。

items.en: a reconstructed root bher- meant to carry.
items.cn: 重构词根 bher- 意为「承载」。

items.en: bridel named the headgear, a derivative of bregdan, to pull quickly.
items.cn: 古英语 bridel 指马勒，一般认为是 bregdan（迅速拉拽）的派生词。

items.en: bridel became bridel and bridle; the verb to restrain appeared.
items.cn: 中古英语拼作 bridel、bridle，并出现「约束」的动词用法。

items.en: the sense of showing anger by lifting the head is recorded.
items.cn: 昂首表示嗔怒的用法在十六世纪见于记载。

items.en: bridle keeps all three senses: the gear, the check, the flaring temper.
items.cn: 如今 bridle 三义并存：马具、约束、勃然变色。

note.en: Bridle is often confused with bridal, and it neighbours a set of horse-gear words.
note.cn: bridle 极易与 bridal 混淆，同时与一组马具词相邻。

entries.definition: relating to a bride or a wedding
entries.definitionCN: 新娘的；婚礼的——只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a path for riders on horseback
entries.definitionCN: 马道，由 bridle 加 way 构成
不受约束的，un- 否定 bridle 而来

entries.definition: the gear that attaches a horse to a cart
entries.definitionCN: 马具（挽具），与马勒分工不同

entries.definition: a long strap used to guide a horse

entries.definitionCN: 制止；约束，与 bridle 的动词义相近

entries.definition: to control or limit; also a bit type
entries.definitionCN: 抑制；亦指一种马嚼（curb bit）

entries.definition: the seat fastened on a horse's back
entries.definitionCN: 马鞍，与马勒同属骑乘装备

normalIntro.en: Tie bridle to bridleway and unbridled to keep the family together.
normalIntro.cn: 把 bridle 与 bridleway、unbridled 串成一个词族来记。

normal.en: Bridle and bridal sound the same; the gear has an L for leather.
normal.cn: bridle 与 bridal 同音；马具的 L 想成皮革（leather）。

normal.en: Unbridled passion is a horse with no bridle.
normal.cn: unbridled（放纵的）就是没戴马勒的马。

normal.en: A bridleway is a road for bridled horses.
normal.cn: bridleway 就是供戴马勒之马走的路。

normal.en: Bridle at a remark: the head jerks like the horse's.
normal.cn: bridle at 某句话：头一昂，如马受勒。

normal.en: Rein, curb, bridle: three straps of one system.
normal.cn: 缰、嚼、勒：同一控马系统的三件套。

abstract.en: Feel cool leather straps cross your palm at the stable door.
abstract.cn: 在厩门边感受革带冰凉地划过掌心。

abstract.en: See a stallion fling its head against the pull of the bit.
abstract.cn: 看见烈马顶着嚼口的拉力猛甩头。

abstract.en: Picture anger rearing up like a horse, then being reined in.
abstract.cn: 想象怒气如马人立而起，又被缰绳勒回。

examples.en: The groom washed the bit and hung up the bridle.
examples.cn: 马夫洗净嚼口，把马勒挂好。

examples.en: Laws were passed to bridle the power of the guilds.
examples.cn: 通过了约束行会权力的法律。

examples.en: She bridled at the accusation and left the room.
examples.cn: 她听到指控便昂首动怒，离开了房间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不啦抖」——马一戴笼头就「不啦」乱「抖」，人也一样，受勒便昂首「不啦抖」地动怒。

root: bridle 源自古英语 bridel（马勒），一般认为是 bregdan（迅速拉拽）的派生词，词根上溯至原始印欧语 bher-（承载）。核心意象是「用革带勒住、引导」。

sensesIntro.en: The concrete headgear first, then the checking of anything wild, then the flaring of temper.
sensesIntro.cn: 先有具体的马勒，再长出对一切狂放之物的约束，最后长出昂首嗔怒之态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: leather straps holding a horse's head.
core.cn: 核心意象：革带勒住马头。

intro.en: Bridle forms compounds and one famous negated adjective.
intro.cn: bridle 构成复合词和一个著名的否定形容词。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic; Latin kin are cognates, not sources.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼语族，拉丁语同源词仅是亲属而非来源。

items.meaning: the act of restraining or flaring up

latinEntries.meaningCN: 勒住之物；缰勒（义近而非同源）
